A quoted sed -i and a later find -exec also skip the safety check. Starting a session worktree runs repository hooks before the trust prompt. Approving git clean can delete ignored files the prompt does not name. A Local-to-cloud continuation uploads the session title. Setup and the lock check run `sh` and `kill` from PATH. Unread CLI files also forbid SHIP. |

## Fixes before a SHIP call

Web, and any Desktop session that uses the hosted app:

1. Apply the 18+ decision on API-key chat completions and audio transcription. Do not treat a commercial-terms exemption as an age decision.
2. Size the Code session lease above the 740 second turn budget, or refuse Changes, commands, and commits while a turn holds the session.
3. Do not treat `api` or `unknown` as allowed when a workspace has set `allowedSurfaces`. Image, video, live voice, embeddings, and API-key chat must carry a real surface.
4. Ask for a destructive confirmation before a shorter Code session retention is saved.
5. Send the support email when a live wait times out, instead of stopping the poll that is the only timely sender.
6. On Android, delete an export file only after the app the person picked has finished reading it.
7. Refuse a code-execution sandbox when the chat completion has no conversation id, and do not skip the compute reservation.
8. Run managed-worktree `sh` and `kill` by absolute path, with PATH cleared.
9. Reject a managed hook whose path becomes `..` after shell escape handling.
10. Count image and PDF attachments with a media estimate, not base64 length divided by four.
11. Do not replace an editor device session with the CLI access token when refresh fails.
12. On the recovery-hold screen, say that Sign out ends the only session that can finish recovery, or do not end that session.
13. Send the security email when the in-app notification insert fails.
14. Do not attach image bytes from an @ mention until the workspace is trusted.
15. Do not hardcode the mainland DashScope host for Qwen. Resolve it from configuration.
16. Start only installed plugin MCP servers from Test, Tools, Inspect, and plugin login.
17. Apply a domain deny to the browser result field tabUrl.
18. Keep the provider usage anchor while deciding whether a compacted transcript still fits.
19. Key plugin settings and keychain secrets by install location, not by folder name.
20. Do not accept a wildcard Code extra host after checking only the apex address.
21. Apply the connector deny check to MCP resource reads, not only to tool calls.
22. Replace an existing file by writing a temporary file first, instead of truncating it before the new bytes land.
23. Treat protected path names with the same case fold the filesystem uses, not only Rust lowercase.
24. Rate destructive Git actions High so Allow All does not auto-approve them.
25. Report a failed, timed-out, partial, or cancelled unattended Chrome Cloud run as an error.
26. When Specific people sharing is saved, keep grants for people who were not on the first page of 100 members, or show those people before the save can remove them.
27. On Chrome sign-out, keep that account's saved recordings, or say that Log out deletes them before it does.
28. When Computer use cannot name the front application, refuse the keystroke or click, or ask before sending it.
29. When a computer-use step exceeds 15 seconds, stop the input helper before telling the user it failed.
30. List every path git clean will delete, including ignored files, before the approval.
31. Do not copy a Local session title into the cloud conversation unless the consent draft shows it.
32. Stamp a session handoff with the session's real Local, BYOK, or Managed mode.
33. Do not store the text Chrome computer use typed in the side-panel step detail.
34. Redact a one-time code or passphrase in a non-password field before that value leaves the page.
35. Treat a field as sensitive when its visible label says social security, not only when an attribute contains ssn.
36. Run session worktree creation through the hardened host git path, before any repository hook or fsmonitor can run.
37. Honor a UserPromptSubmit block in the classic REPL before the prompt is sent.
38. Apply the credential-file filter to staged and unstaged diffs in agi review.
39. Keep a Chrome video task on the assistant when the model changes or another message is sent while that video is starting, and show Stop until the start finishes.
40. When a person approves a repository, grant the folder they picked, or stop if git's toplevel is a different directory.
41. Treat a shell option's value as a value, so bash -o pipefail -c still subjects the script to the never-run check.
42. Classify find, ripgrep, and base64 from the parsed arguments, so a quoted or clustered dangerous flag is not Safe.
43. Label git rm, git switch --discard-changes, and git -C ... clean as a delete or a write, not as a read.
44. Do not treat a quoted sed -i or sed -e as a file name.
45. Check every find -exec action, not only the first.

Every surface: finish reading the unread non-skipped files below before anyone marks that surface SHIP.

Those keys leave auto-memory, decay, and the fact cap unsaved.                                                                    | Commit the memory settings on Enter, and name that key.                                 |
| CLI-COMMAND-PALETTE-NO-WINDOW-01             | P2       | CLI                   | `apps/cli/src/tui/widgets/command_popup.rs:155`                                                                              | The slash palette draws every command with no window, so the highlight leaves the screen and Enter can run a command the user cannot see.                                                  | Window the palette so the highlighted command stays on screen.                          |
| CLI-MENTION-SPACE-DROPS-01                   | P2       | CLI                   | `apps/cli/src/tui/widgets/mention_popup.rs:80`                                                                               | Space closes the @ file picker and drops the space, so the next word sticks to @ and is sent as a workspace path.                                                                          | Insert the space when the picker closes.                                                |

- `listed = read + skipped` is false while unread files remain. That fails the coverage gate. No surface is SHIP.
- Shards cut at about 280 KB and at most 36 files, along folder boundaries: 1,020 shards. Unread files were repacked into 5,236 smaller shards.
